claims: C1 a system or developer message lists the available tools
C2 each listed tool includes documentation of its functionality
C3 each listed tool includes documentation of the syntax to use in a message to that tool

concepts.name: tool_definition
concepts.gloss: T is a program that can be called by the assistant to perform a specific task

concepts.name: system_or_developer_message
concepts.gloss: M is a message with the system or developer role that configures the assistant
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of a system or developer message, so a class of such messages is presupposed

concepts.name: lists_tool
concepts.gloss: message M lists tool T among the available tools

concepts.name: documents_functionality
concepts.gloss: the listing of tool T in message M includes documentation of T's functionality

concepts.name: documents_message_syntax
concepts.gloss: the listing of tool T in message M includes documentation of the syntax to use in a message to T

ontology.gloss: M is a system or developer message that lists tool T
the listing of tool T in system or developer message M documents T's functionality
the listing of tool T in system or developer message M documents the syntax to use in a message to T
